title: A Daytime Eclipse: Moon Occults Venus
explanation: There was something behind the clouds.  Upon close inspection, it was the Moon, which was hard to see yesterday around noon above the small village of Cessy, France.  But soon, it was not only the Moon. As expected, a bright dot suddenly appeared from behind the Moon -- the planet Venus far in the distance.
